source.legs: M-D17: leg A on classroom_dolly.json's line, from back_of_room (0.897, -3.793, 1.6) to near_board (0.897, 0.759, 1.6), yarbus-agent REPORT.md (MEASURED), 4.552 m in 46 steps of 0.0990 m; a turn in place of +70.22 deg (left) at P = near_board; leg B straight from P toward the front door's centre, 27 steps of 0.0990 m (2.673 m), ending at clearance from the door (leg_B)
source.leg_B: MEASURED (D1b Step 0, #19, Code, workstation; motion/bl_objects.py and the depsgraph's mesh instances of scenes/classroom/classroom_eye.blend, docs/runs/issue-19/step0/): the front door is in the left wall (inner face x = -2.445), doorFrame x -2.551..-2.472, y 1.420..2.502 (centre y 1.961); its leaf (Box25.001) stands ajar into the room, at head height (1.3-1.9 m) from (-2.445, 2.29) to (-2.13, 1.71). Leg B aims at the doorway's centre on the wall's inner face (-2.445, 1.961): heading (-0.940988, 0.338440, 0). The free strip: the first desk row ends at y <= 0.55, and the front furniture (leatherChair y >= 2.04 at x -1.55..-0.79; teacherDesk x 1.60..2.98, y 1.24..1.83) leaves the leg clear by >= 0.39 m in plan (the AABBs of every mesh instance below 1.85 m; nearest: the first row's chair.019 and leatherChair) for 27 steps; from step 28 on, the door's handle (Cube.024, 0.31 m) and leaf come nearer. So leg B ends after 27 steps of 0.0990 m, at (-1.618261, 1.663651, 1.6): 0.44 m (plan) from the leaf, 0.83 m from the wall. P stays at near_board. Preflight of the six phases (OPTIX, 720 px, 4 spp): PASS, nearest surface >= 0.45 m on leg B (at its end: the leaf), holes <= 0.0376; leg B's target ray hits the leaf at (-2.206, 1.875, 1.6)
